author: TheMasterClock
body:
Alright, my appeal is already closed and I think this is the best place to put this. Sorry I keep stressing about this punishment but I really don't understand why.

Staff member: Falz

Reason of Complaint: Excessive punishing 

Explanation: Clearly I do have a ton of infractions in my profile. However, out of all in the past 8 months, 2 of them involve rudeness which is a warn and a 5 day ban. I don't understand why it went way high up. 14 day is reasonable.
ALSO, THE MAIN REASON WHY I'M MAKING THIS: When I look at the evidence, Heinrik(a decent mod) states in staff chat that I should get a 15 day ban which makes SO MUCH SENSE. But then after his message, falz decides to bump it up to 30 days. Don't understand why he did this but the punishment that Heinrik suggest is 100% reasonable. 

Evidence: https://prnt.sc/gvemyb

P.S. Heinrik made a good decision and he's exceeds his performance as a moderator so think of him as a good mod :)

Thanks, 
Clock
